summary: Round C fixes the named F2, F4, F9, and F12 test gaps. The documented deviations for F10, F11, and F16 disclose unmet phase criteria but do not satisfy them. F1 and F3's contests hold under the stated fault-detection comparison.
blocking_findings: F10 [Blocker] review-a: FIX — The phase has no matching GREEN evidence for D5 part 2. gate-7008ccef.json reports exit 0, but green-7008ccef.log:1–13 contains an accounting plan. The matching coverage log shows 3,081 passing cases and 89.94% lines. Supply the required GREEN log at commit 7008ccef or rerun that command through the shared runner. | CONTEST kept: plan.md:179 records the missing GREEN log and the successful coverage run, but test-strategy.md:25–37 requires a separate GREEN run; transparent deviation evidence does not meet that gate.

F11 [Blocker] review-a: FIX — The D1 commit also rewrites two R2 cases. classification.md:195 assigns the rendered full-width pictured row and the text-only exclusion cases to R2. 0be4a037 changes both. Keep these R2 cases outside the D1 change so each test commit holds one class. | CONTEST kept: plan.md:178 documents the mixed-class commit and says history will not be rewritten, but neither the plan nor the source spec approves an exception to the one-class rule.

F16 [Blocker] review-a: The new plan entry at lines 151–155 closes three remediation commits with evidence only at 9eb3b9c4. It does not show tests or coverage at 733319505 or fb5622ed7. Spec criteria (b) and (c) require both results at every commit. | CONTEST kept: plan.md:180 records that the two commits were gated together, but test-strategy.md:186–192 and spec.md:70–72 require successful test and coverage evidence after every commit.
nonblocking_findings: F17 [Nit] review-a: The unused compiledCss export is removed, but the full feature and pricing locale-key lists remain duplicated between www-features-pricing.locale.test.ts, www-features-page.content.test.tsx, and www-pricing-page.content.test.tsx. Keep each required list in one fixture.
